description: Create a new note in the user's library with a title and markdown body. Optional note_type and originator fields record whose teaching it was. Returns the new note's id and URL. For a short thought or quote, save_capture is the lighter option; to add to an existing note, use edit_note.

attribution_date.description: Date the original teaching happened, as YYYY-MM-DD, if known (e.g. the date of a sermon). Only meaningful alongside originator_name — omit otherwise.

attribution_type.description: What kind of source the originator is (e.g. 'Sermon', 'Book', 'Podcast', 'Conversation'). Only meaningful alongside originator_name — omit otherwise.

originator_name.description: Who originally taught/wrote this, if it's someone else's teaching (e.g. a pastor or author) rather than the user's own thought. Omit for the user's own notes.

name: create_note
title: Create note
